isbi_2024_title: ISBI 2024 - Multi-Scale Component-Tree for Enhanced Representation in Multiplex Immunohistochemistry Imaging
isbi_2024_background_paragraph_1: The 21st International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI 2024) took place between the 27th and 30th May 2024 in Athina (Athens), Greece. The official conference website can be consulted through this link.
isbi_2024_background_paragraph_2: I presented a poster to support the publication of the short article Multi-Scale Component-Tree for Enhanced Representation in Multiplex Immunohistochemistry Imaging in the conference proceedings (see this link). The article and poster showcase the use of the Multi-Scale Component-Tree (MSCT) to represent Immunohistochemistry images both uniplexed and multiplexed. The ability of the MSCT to segment and classify cells based on a "feature vector"-like approach is also illustrated as a potential use case of said MSCT.
